findings.title: Do not leave later flusher processes running when the join deadline expires
findings.body: This `break` exits the loop over all processes. If `next_step.join(timeout)` has already used the deadline, or an earlier process consumes it, later processes never reach `process.terminate()`. A worker that is hung or blocked can therefore continue using Redis and Kafka after the strategy's timed shutdown returns.

findings.title: Reject nonpositive flusher process counts
findings.body: The CLI accepts any integer for `--flusher-processes`. A value of `0` is treated as unset here and silently selects one process per shard, potentially creating far more workers than configured. A negative value produces a negative `num_processes`, then shard distribution indexes an empty process map and fails consumer initialization. Validate that configured counts are positive rather than interpreting or failing on them unexpectedly.

findings.title: The process-limit test exercises threads, not multiprocessing
findings.body: Passing `produce_to_pipe` selects the `threading.Thread` path in `SpanFlusher`; this test's process-count assertions therefore do not exercise the production spawn-process path. It cannot catch failures specific to spawning workers or sharing synchronization state across processes, so the new multiprocessing behavior remains unverified by this test.
